module: "Preview" panel of the mission editor. It checks the presence and size of the preview image (preview.png/jpg/jpeg, expected at 1920x1080, <= 1024 KB) and of the thumbnail (thumbnail.*, square between 200 and 400 px, <= 100 KB) in the mission folder, displays tooltips with the images and reports the issues to the Issues tab. The module returns a constructor: require(...)(missionEditor).
notes: Bug: in draw, the thumbnail size test compares size.y to 200 twice (size.y == 200 and size.y == 200); size.x is not checked for the green icon. getMissionIssues, on the other hand, does check for a square thumbnail between 200 and 400 px, so the two checks do not match.
If no thumbnail is found but the preview exists, the preview is used as the thumbnail ("Using Preview as Thumbnail!" warning).
The preference missionEditor.general.alwaysShowScreenshots permanently displays both images in the panel.

C.desc: Instance of the panel. Fields: missionEditor, mission, previewFile, previewFound, previewImage, thumbFile, thumbFound, thumbImage (texObj objects from ui/imguiUtils).

setMission.desc: Sets the current mission and reruns checkPreview.

checkPreview.desc: Determines the preview and thumbnail files (mission.previewFile / thumbnailFile or gameplay_missions_missions.getMissionPreviewFilepath / getThumbnailFilepath), indicates whether they are found and loads their textures.

getMissionIssues.desc: Calls setMission(m) then returns the issues: missing file (error), dimensions or weight out of limits (warning).

draw.desc: Draws the status icons, the hover previews, the button that opens the mission folder and the "Always show Preview" checkbox.
